entries.deep_essence: Six Dynasties zhiguai (志怪) by Liu Jingshu (刘敬叔). Records omens, ghost encounters, spirit retribution, and local lore as evidence of ganying (感应) between human conduct and the unseen realm. Doctrines: renbao (人报) and wubao (物报); mountain/river gods intervening in human affairs; dreams as prophetic channels; objects with ling (灵). Methods: short anecdote form, often ending with verification (验). Terminology: 怪、神、鬼、报应、托梦、物怪. Not systematic Daoist theory but a primary store of pre-Tang spirit-world materials later mined by Daoist and leishu compilers.
entries.key_passages: 元嘉中，有人夜行，见一女子，自称某地神女。；有人得古镜，照见亡者，遂以为宝。；山神示梦，令勿伐木，违者病死。
entries.application: Dùng làm nguồn trích dẫn về cảm ứng, báo ứng và thần núi khi giải thích mộng/điềm trong bói toán. Đối chiếu với 搜神记 để phân biệt zhiguai Nam triều.
entries.related: 搜神记; 幽明录; 宣室志

entries.deep_essence: Qing zhiguai-biji by He Bang'e (和邦额), Manchu banner official. Blend of fox spirits (狐仙), dream omens, karmic justice, and social satire under Confucian-Daoist-Buddhist syncretism. Doctrines: 狐可修仙、人狐姻缘、善恶必报; foxes as cultivators of neidan-like longevity. Methods: conversational night-talk framing (夜谭), multi-episode character arcs. Terminology: 狐仙、报恩、托生、冥报、幻化. Reflects Qing popular Daoism where xianjing (仙境) and renjian (人间) interpenetrate; useful for late-imperial fox cult and spirit-medium motifs.
entries.key_passages: 狐亦有道，能修炼成仙。；夜坐谭异，闻者悚然。；善者得报，恶者获谴，不爽毫发。
entries.application: Tham chiếu khi luận hồ tiên, báo ứng và giao thoa tiên–thế ở đời Thanh. So với 聊斋志异 về mô típ tu luyện của hồ.
entries.related: 聊斋志异; 耳食录; 谐铎

entries.deep_essence: Tang collection by Zhang Du (张读). Named after the Xuan Shi hall where Han Wendi heard Jia Yi on ghosts—signaling court interest in shenyi (神异). Content: Daoist adepts, talismans (符), alchemy, mountain recluses, prophetic dreams, and Buddhist-Daoist contest miracles. Doctrines: 道术可驱邪; 符籙禁劾; fate revealed through omens. Methods: narrative verification of fangshi (方士) techniques. Terminology: 道士、符、丹、精魅、托梦、谪仙. Bridges zhiguai and religious hagiography; key for Tang Daoist miracle narratives and official–adept interaction.
entries.key_passages: 有道士以符驱魅，其疾立愈。；梦神告曰：某日当有验。；仙人谪在人间，常混迹市井。
entries.application: Dùng cho phép thuật Đường (phù, trục tà) và mộng triện trong sử liệu quan phương. Đối chiếu 酉阳杂俎 về đạo sĩ–tinh quái.
entries.related: 酉阳杂俎; 玄怪录; 异苑

entries.deep_essence: Northern Wei stele at Songshan (嵩山) Lingmiao, critical epigraphic witness to early medieval Daoism under Kou Qianzhi (寇谦之) reform and imperial patronage of Central Peak cult. Doctrines: 中岳为土德之镇; temple as site of jiao (醮) and imperial fengshan-style legitimacy; deity hierarchy of yue (岳) gods. Methods: stele text combines eulogy, cosmography, and ritual space description. Terminology: 灵庙、中岳、嵩高、醮祀、神道. Documents how Northern courts institutionalized mountain worship within Daoist state cult, linking cosmology (wuxing, five peaks) to political mandate.
entries.key_passages: 中岳嵩高，土德之镇。；灵庙肃穆，以妥神祇。；皇帝虔奉，修祀不忒。
entries.application: Nghiên cứu Ngũ Nhạc, đền Trung Nhạc và Đạo giáo Bắc Ngụy–triều đình. Kết hợp 西岳华山庙碑 để so sánh bia sùng bái núi.
entries.related: 西岳华山庙碑; 魏书·释老志; 岱岳观造像记碑

entries.deep_essence: Song imperial leishu Taiping Yulan's Dao sections compile pre-Song excerpts on Dao, De, xian (仙), zhaijiao (斋醮), dantian, fangzhong, and hagiography from lost sources. Organizational logic: topical classing (类书) preserves fragments of Daozang-adjacent literature. Doctrines represented: Laozi deification, immortality techniques, ritual calendar, mountain reclusion. Methods: extract-and-cite; primary tool for reconstructing lost zhiguai and Daoist technical phrases. Terminology: 道、仙、斋、醮、服食、导引、房中. Essential bibliography layer between primary scriptures and later encyclopedic digests.
entries.key_passages: 道者，万物之奥。；仙人好楼居，餐风饮露。；斋戒以事神，醮以通真。
entries.application: Tra cứu trích đoạn Đạo giáo tiền Tống đã thất truyền; đối chiếu mục 灵异 trong các leishu khác. Nguồn tra cứu thuật ngữ phục thực, đạo dẫn.
entries.related: 艺文类聚·灵异部; 云笈七签; 天中记

entries.deep_essence: Song institutional encyclopedia Cefu Yuangui, section on imperial portents (符瑞). Systematizes auspicious omens as political theology: dragons, phoenixes, sweet dew, yellow river clarity, prophetic charts (图谶) validate tianming (天命). Doctrines: 符命、瑞应、受命之符; emperor as pivot of cosmic response. Methods: chronological listing of reported omens by reign—administrative memory of ganying. Terminology: 符瑞、嘉禾、景星、黄龙、谶纬. Core for understanding how court historiography absorbed Daoist-eschatological and Confucian omen science into state legitimacy discourse.
entries.key_passages: 王者德至，则符瑞出。；黄龙见，以为受命之符。；景星出，嘉禾生，天下和。
entries.application: Phân tích phù thụy và chính thống đế vương; gắn điềm lành với mệnh trời khi đọc sử. So với 玉海·郊祀 về nghi lễ–điềm ứng.
entries.related: 玉海·郊祀; 宋书·符瑞志; 太平御览

entries.deep_essence: Wang Yinglin's (王应麟) Song encyclopedic handbook Yuhai, jiaosi (郊祀) chapters: suburban sacrifices to Heaven/Earth, peak and river rites, ancestral and state cult schedules. Doctrines: 郊以事天、社以事地; ritual calendrics; fangze, yuanqiu. Methods: cite classics (Liji, Zhouli), histories, and Song institutions side by side for examination (keju) utility. Terminology: 郊祀、圜丘、方泽、五岳、四渎、明堂. Links state ritual to cosmological topography—five peaks, four rivers—shared with Daoist sacred geography, though framed as Confucian li.
entries.key_passages: 郊祀所以事天也。；五岳视三公，四渎视诸侯。；圜丘祭天，方泽祭地。
entries.application: Tra nghi tế Giao Xã, Ngũ Nhạc–Tứ Độc trong chế độ nhà nước. Kết hợp bia miếu Nhạc để hiểu thực hành sùng bái núi.
entries.related: 册府元龟·帝王部·符瑞; 文献通考·郊社; 西岳华山庙碑

entries.deep_essence: Ming leishu by Chen Yaowen (陈耀文). Broad topical digest including shenxian, lingyi, mountains, and omens, drawing heavily on earlier class books and biji. Doctrines transmitted secondhand: immortality lore, local cult miracles, portent taxonomy. Methods: thematic aggregation with source tags—research tool rather than original revelation. Terminology: 神仙、灵异、灾祥、山川. Valuable for Ming reception history of medieval Daoist and zhiguai materials; cross-checks parallel entries in Taiping Yulan and Yiwen Leiju.
entries.key_passages: 神仙之说，自古有之。；灵异之事，载于群书。；山川出云，神灵所宅。
entries.application: Leishu tra cứu thần tiên–linh dị đời Minh; đối chiếu trích dẫn với 太平御览 và 艺文类聚. Hữu ích khi phục nguyên trích đoạn rời.
entries.related: 太平御览·道部; 艺文类聚·灵异部; 渊鉴类函

entries.deep_essence: Early Tang leishu Yiwen Leiju (Ouyang Xun et al.), Lingyi (灵异) section: curated literary excerpts on spirits, anomalies, divine responses, and wonder tales from Han–Six Dynasties sources. Doctrines implicit in selection: heaven-human resonance, ghostly justice, numinous animals/places. Methods: 事 and 文 paired (event + poem/prose)—template for later class books. Terminology: 灵异、感应、鬼物、祥瑞、灾异. Foundational for how Tang elite classified the supernatural as a bibliographic category distinct from pure rujia classics, feeding both literary zhiguai and religious proof-texts.
entries.key_passages: 灵异之事， sens 通于神明。；感于善则祥，感于恶则殃。；鬼神之情状，圣人所难言。
entries.application: Nguồn gốc phân loại 灵异 trong leishu; tra trích thơ–văn về quái dị tiền Đường. Nền cho 太平御览 các bộ tương tự.
entries.related: 太平御览·道部; 北堂书钞; 初学记

entries.deep_essence: Early Ming chuanqi collection by Qu You (瞿佑). Romance, ghosts, underworld courts, and karmic plots in ornate prose; revived Tang-style tale after Song historiography turn. Doctrines: 冥司公正、情可感鬼、轮回果报; underworld bureaucracy mirrors mortal yamen. Methods: framed narratives, poetry exchanges with spirits, historical settings. Terminology: 冥府、再世、幽婚、冤魂. Influenced Korean/Japanese adaptations and later Qing zhiguai; bridges literary fiction and popular religious imagination of diyu (地狱) and yuanhun (冤魂).
entries.key_passages: 人死为鬼，鬼死为聻。；冥司赏罚，不爽于人间。；情之所钟，生死相感。
entries.application: Phân tích minh ty, oan hồn và tình–quỷ trong văn học Minh. So với 聊斋 và 耳食录 về mô típ tái thế–u hôn.
entries.related: 剪灯余话; 聊斋志异; 夜谭随录

entries.deep_essence: Qing zhiguai by Yue Jun (乐钧). Title alludes to hearsay ('eating with the ear')—ironic epistemology of anomaly tales. Mix of foxes, immortals, retribution, and literati self-reflection. Doctrines: 果报昭彰、狐仙济世、梦兆先机. Methods: polished classical narrative with authorial comments questioning credibility while affirming moral order. Terminology: 耳食、狐媚、果报、仙踪. Complements Liaozhai school; useful for mid-Qing merchant–gentry spirit beliefs and ethical reading of weird accounts.
entries.key_passages: 耳食之言，不可尽信，亦不可尽不信。；善恶之报，如影随形。；狐仙有德，能庇其一方。
entries.application: Nghiên cứu báo ứng và hồ tiên đời Thanh với giọng hoài nghi–đạo đức. Đối chiếu 谐铎 về châm biếm xã hội trong chí quái.
entries.related: 谐铎; 聊斋志异; 萤窗异草

entries.deep_essence: Qing collection by Shen Qifeng (沈起凤). 'Harmonious/warning bells'—satirical zhiguai where ghosts, foxes, and immortals expose human hypocrisy, exam culture, and official greed. Doctrines: moral ganying wrapped in comedy; 以鬼讽人、以狐砭俗. Methods: punchline structures, allegory, inversion of human/spirit hierarchy. Terminology: 铎、讽喻、狐鬼、科场. Important for reading Qing anomaly literature as social critique rather than pure religious proof; still encodes popular Daoist-Buddhist cosmology as stage machinery.
entries.key_passages: 铎以警世，谐以醒人。；鬼犹如此，人何以堪。；科场如傀儡，神鬼实操之。
entries.application: Đọc chí quái như châm biếm quan trường–khoa cử; tách lớp vũ trụ quan đạo–phật khỏi lớp trào phúng. So với 聊斋 và 耳食录.
entries.related: 耳食录; 聊斋志异; 夜雨秋灯录

entries.deep_essence: Late Qing biji-zhiguai by Xuan Ding (宣鼎). Atmospheric 'night rain, autumn lamp' framing; tales of chivalry, ghosts, courtesans, and strange crafts with sentimental and theatrical flair. Doctrines: residual 因果 and xia (侠) ethics; spirit justice amid dynastic decline. Methods: long-form stories, dialogue-heavy scenes, local color (Jiangnan). Terminology: 秋灯、侠义、冤抑、异人. Captures late-imperial popular religion meeting modern print culture; bridge to Republican strange-tale magazines.
entries.key_passages: 夜雨秋灯，追述见闻。；侠骨义胆，可动鬼神。；冤抑不伸，终有冥报。
entries.application: Nguồn văn hóa tín ngưỡng–hiệp nghĩa cuối Thanh; mộng báo và oan ức trong bối cảnh xã hội suy tàn. Liên hệ 右台仙馆笔记.
entries.related: 右台仙馆笔记; 谐铎; 萤窗异草

entries.deep_essence: Qing biji by Yu Yue (俞樾), classicist and polymath. 'Youtai immortal lodge notes'—measured records of anomalies, dreams, medical curiosities, and hearsay filtered by kaoju (考据) habit. Doctrines: cautious affirmation of 事出有因; interest in fate, longevity recipes, and cult practices without full confessional Daoism. Methods: short entries, source criticism, comparison of variants. Terminology: 笔记、异事、梦验、方技. Elite scholarly mediation of popular numinous claims; valuable for 19th-c. intellectual attitudes toward shenyi.
entries.key_passages: 余于右台仙馆，随笔录异。；事虽近怪，理或可通。；梦兆之验，往往而有。
entries.application: Nghiên cứu thái độ học giả Thanh đối với dị sự và mộng nghiệm. Kết hợp 茶香室丛钞 của cùng tác giả để tra dị văn.
entries.related: 茶香室丛钞; 夜雨秋灯录; 耳食录

entries.deep_essence: Qing zhiguai attributed to Changbai haogezi (长白浩歌子) / related to Manchu literary circles; 'firefly-window strange herbs/tales'. Romantic fox and immortal affairs, ornate diction, strong female spirit protagonists. Doctrines: 情通仙凡、修真可成、报恩复仇. Methods: literary chuanqi length, emotional interiority. Terminology: 异草、狐女、仙缘、幻境. Part of post-Liaozhai boom; maps Qing erotic-immortal imagination onto cultivation tropes (caibu anxiety, dual cultivation shadows) without being technical neidan manual.
entries.key_passages: 萤窗之下，录彼异草。；仙凡路隔，情丝可通。；狐女有心，不让贞淑。
entries.application: Phân tích tình duyên hồ–tiên và tu chân văn học hóa đời Thanh. So 聊斋, 夜谭随录 về nữ tinh và tiên cảnh.
entries.related: 聊斋志异; 夜谭随录; 耳食录

entries.deep_essence: Eastern Han stele associated with Huashan temple cult (classic text often linked to calligraphy tradition of the Xiyue Huashan Miaobei). Documents Western Peak as metal-phase guardian, imperial and local sacrifice, and mountain god titulature. Doctrines: 西岳主金、白帝少昊系统; peak gods in wuyue network under Han state religion proto-Daoist sacred geography. Methods: stele eulogy + ritual charter. Terminology: 西岳、华山、庙碑、金天、望祭. Cornerstone epigraphy for five-peak worship later absorbed into Daoist yuejiao (岳醮) and pilgrimage culture.
entries.key_passages: 西岳华山，金天作镇。；庙貌尊严，以承祭祀。；望于山川，徧于群神。
entries.application: Khảo cổ văn bia và thần học Ngũ Nhạc; nền cho tế Hoa Sơn và Đạo giáo sơn nhạc. Đối chiếu 中岳嵩高灵庙碑.
entries.related: 中岳嵩高灵庙碑; 泰山刻石; 玉海·郊祀

entries.deep_essence: Qin Shi Huang's Mount Tai inscriptions (and later Han/Tang recuts/tradition) proclaiming imperial unification after fengshan (封禅). Doctrines: 受命于天、封禅告成; mountain as cosmic axis for announcing political virtue to Heaven. Methods: stone-carved propaganda, standardized seal script prestige. Terminology: 封禅、刻石、泰一、受命. Foundational political-theology of sacred peaks; Daoist later re-read Tai as Dongyue (东岳) underworld-administrative center (Dongyue Dadi), layering salvationist bureaucracy onto Qin-Han imperial mountain rite.
entries.key_passages: 皇帝临位，作制明法。；登兹泰山，周览东极。；亲巡远方，登于泰山，周览东极。
entries.application: Giải phong thiện–khắc thạch như tuyên bố mệnh trời; nối với Đông Nhạc đại đế trong Đạo giáo dân gian. So bia Hoa Sơn–Tung Sơn.
entries.related: 史记·封禅书; 西岳华山庙碑; 岱岳观造像记碑

entries.deep_essence: Northern Wei Daoist image dedication inscription by Yao Boduo (often dated ~496 CE, Shaanxi). One of the most important early Daoist zaoxiangji (造像记): donors commission stone image of Heavenly Worthies for parents' salvation and family's fortune. Doctrines: 造像功德、拔度先亡、合家眷属; fusion of Daoist deities with Buddhist-style merit transfer. Methods: votive formula—date, donor, motive, prayer. Terminology: 造像记、天尊、愿文、眷属. Proves Northern Dynasties lay Daoism used iconic worship and stele-like merit rhetoric parallel to Buddhism.
entries.key_passages: 敬造石像一区，愿使先亡父母。；合家眷属，常与善缘。；愿亡者升仙，存者吉利。
entries.application: Nghiên cứu công đức tạo tượng Đạo giáo Bắc triều và nguyện văn cứu độ. So 岱岳观造像记碑 về hình thức cúng tạo.
entries.related: 岱岳观造像记碑; 魏书·释老志; 中岳嵩高灵庙碑

entries.deep_essence: Tang (and multi-period) inscriptions at Daiyue Abbey (岱岳观) on Mount Tai area—records of Daoist image-making, jiao rites, and official–clerical patronage of Dongyue cult. Doctrines: 东岳主生死、醮祭祈福、造像延生. Methods: serial stele entries documenting ritual calendar and donors over decades. Terminology: 岱岳观、造像记、醮、东岳. Primary field evidence for institutional Daoism at the empire's premier sacred mountain, linking fengshan imperial memory to Tang zhaijiao practice and popular underworld administration cults.
entries.key_passages: 于岱岳观敬造天尊像。；设醮祈福，以保国宁。；东岳之神，主人生死。
entries.application: Tài liệu thực địa Đạo quán Thái Sơn đời Đường; nối phong thiện với trai giảo và Đông Nhạc. Kết hợp 姚伯多造像记.
entries.related: 姚伯多造像记; 泰山刻石; 西岳华山庙碑

entries.deep_essence: Daoist-medical surgical formulary in the 'immortal-transmitted' (仙传) genre—attributed tradition of external medicine (waike 外科) with empirical prescriptions, abscess/trauma care, and sacred lineage framing. Doctrines: 医道同源、仙方济世; disease as imbalance treatable by fang (方) blessed by immortal authority. Methods: case-tested formulas (集验), topical and internal drugs, surgical manipulation notes. Terminology: 外科、集验方、仙传、疔疮、膏药. Exemplifies how late imperial Daoism claimed technical medicine: hagiographic title legitimizes practical surgery manuals used by itinerant and temple-linked healers.
entries.key_passages: 仙传外科，集诸验方。；疮疡疔毒，依方治之。；医道通仙，济人不倦。
entries.application: Nghiên cứu giao cắt y–đạo: phương ngoại khoa mang danh tiên truyền. Đối chiếu 千金方 và các tiên phương trong Đạo tạng y thư.
entries.related: 千金要方; 肘后备急方; 云笈七签
